note: Nests crew proving the unique-species four-crew framework. Each card uses a unique bird species reserved away from the Major and Aviary Legends species.

suit.name: Nests
suit.domain: materials, craft, work, home, the material world
suit.habitat: community gardens, bike shops, record stalls, laundromats, food-pantry tables, rooftop planters, maker benches, thrift alleys, loading docks, coffee-roastery corners, hardware co-ops
suit.borderFrame: Use the shared Bird Squad frame structure: dark outer keyline, gilded inner filigree rail, four corner medallions, slim vertical side rails, top suit crest medallion, and bottom title cartouche. Keep frame thickness, symmetry, border width, and title placement consistent; place gear, shine, and vine motifs inside the established frame zones.
suit.coreRule: All subjects anatomically bird; streetwear fitted to bird anatomy; no humanoid forms; no gore. Birds have no hands, fingers, wing-hands, wing-arms, extra wings, extra legs, or extra limbs; held props use beak, talons, feet, or legs only. Nests must blend modern hipster streetwear and workwear through distinct card-by-card subcultures: community garden, bike shop, record stall, laundromat/corner store, food-pantry table, rooftop planter crew, maker bench, thrift alley display, loading dock, coffee-roastery corner, and hardware co-op. Use beanies, flannel wraps, hoodies, denim or canvas chore coats, utility vests, aprons, tool slings, salvage satchels, scaffold clips, folding tables, roll-up doors, crates, concrete, work lights, pegboards, cargo bikes, milk crates, planters, and modern shop fixtures. Nest pip counts must use the one count element named on the card and be integrated into work scenes through carried resource tags, built materials, clipped tools, shelves, crates, garlands, or objects the birds are using; avoid alternate count objects, pasted icon rows, isolated prop clusters, and extra charm/tag clutter that could overcount. Avoid old-world fantasy markets, medieval craft stalls, treasure rooms, taverns, robes, cloaks-as-costume, parchment-shop staging, and wizard-shop staging. No readable text on clothing; suit-coded streetwear should use abstract motifs, color, material, and accessories without gang-coded uniforms or affiliation marks.

cards.name: Nest Seed
cards.description: A Satin Bowerbird presents one gleaming shine berry at a modern community garden gate beside stacked milk crates and planter boxes.
cards.pose: Perched at a chain-link community garden gate, one shine berry held carefully in its beak above a talon-side pouch, stacked milk crates and planter boxes behind.
streetwear: slouch beanie and cropped olive chore vest over folded wings
cards.varietyNotes: Suit anchor species. Glossy blue-black bowerbird + offered shine tag reads 'opportunity' at a glance.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Opens materials/resource generation; a seed card that funds later Nests plays.

numberSymbolism.element: one shine berry at the community garden gate
numberSymbolism.represents: first resource, seed capital, and practical opportunity
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly one shine berry or shine tag presented by the Satin Bowerbird.

cards.name: Nest Juggle
cards.description: A European Starling balances two shine tags on a bike-shop cable strung above a repair stand and cargo-bike wheel.
cards.pose: Walking a taut bike-brake cable mid-balance, wings spread wide for stability, two shine tags clipped to a reflective courier harness, cargo-bike wheel below.
streetwear: flannel waist wrap adapted around tail
cards.varietyNotes: Iridescent speckled starling on a wire; spread-wing balance separates it from the perched bowerbird pips.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Resource shuffle; move or rebalance two resources between routes each turn.

numberSymbolism.element: two shine tags balanced on the bike-shop cable
numberSymbolism.represents: resource juggling, rhythm, and practical balance
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly two shine tags balanced by the European Starling.

cards.name: Nest Blueprint
cards.description: Three Hamerkops of the same species build a modular display arch at a neighborhood hardware co-op pegboard, guided by three abstract plan cards.
cards.pose: Three Hamerkops around a half-built pegboard arch, hammer-shaped heads distinct, two threading material by beak and talons while one studies three clipped abstract plan cards.
streetwear: rolled plan tube clipped to scaffold
cards.varietyNotes: Hamerkops keep the communal builder meaning while adding a hammer-headed silhouette and famous nest-building identity.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Build mechanic; multiple workers complete a structure faster for a shared bonus.

numberSymbolism.element: three abstract plan cards guiding the hardware co-op build
numberSymbolism.represents: collaboration, craft, and a shared plan becoming structure
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly three plan cards or build markers around the Hamerkops.

cards.name: Locked Nest
cards.description: A Rock Pigeon guards four shine tags on a concrete storage-unit ledge beside a modern padlocked crate.
cards.pose: Hunched on a storage-unit ledge, wings curled protectively around four shine tags, one tag pinned under a talon, roll-up doors behind.
cards.varietyNotes: City pigeon's gray bulk + closed, hoarding curl contrasts the open offering of the Ace.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Lock/hold effect; freeze your resources to protect them but skip spending.

numberSymbolism.element: four shine tags guarded on the storage-unit ledge
numberSymbolism.represents: holding resources, caution, and possessive security
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly four shine tags protected by the Rock Pigeon. Keep all four tags clustered inward and fully visible after the final border overlay; no tag may sit under the side rail, corner medallion, or title cartouche.

cards.repairDirective: Latest review found only three charms visible after the border because the fourth was cut off. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with the Rock Pigeon and exactly four shine tags pulled closer to the center of the storage-unit ledge. Use a compact two-by-two or tight central cluster; keep every tag fully inside the final border opening and do not add extra charms, coins, tags, or reflections.

cards.name: Cold Nest
cards.description: Two Mourning Doves of the same species huddle outside a laundromat-corner-store window, with five dull shine tags out of reach behind the glass.
cards.pose: Two Mourning Doves in cold alley shadow, feathers fluffed under patched layers, looking toward exactly five dull shine tags displayed behind a warm laundromat window.
cards.varietyNotes: Two huddled pigeons against a lit window; the warm glow stays out of reach, keeping the lack in frame.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Cost/setback card; pay a hardship now to unlock aid or recovery later.

numberSymbolism.element: five dull shine tags behind the laundromat glass
numberSymbolism.represents: scarcity, hardship, and needing help nearby
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly five dull shine tags behind the laundromat glass near the Mourning Doves; the five tags must be prominent and countable, with no extra shine tags, charms, coins, or resource markers.

cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates looked realistic instead of matching the game art. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with crisp clusters and deliberate dithering, not realistic painting. Keep the two Mourning Doves, laundromat window, and exactly five dull shine tags centered inside the overlay-safe area.

cards.name: Shared Nest
cards.description: A Common Myna runs a mutual-aid folding table, sharing seed with two smaller Common Mynas while six brass resource tokens sit beside a digital scale.
cards.pose: Perched at a folding food-pantry table, seed packet held in its beak, two smaller Common Mynas below, exactly six brass resource tokens arranged beside a digital scale.
streetwear: soft bucket hat fitted to crest line
plain apron loops with no token shapes
cards.varietyNotes: Same starling as the Two, now generous and grounded; the level scale signals fairness.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Distribute effect; share resources to allies with a balancing payoff.

numberSymbolism.element: six brass resource tokens beside the digital scale
numberSymbolism.represents: generosity, mutual aid, and fair exchange
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly six brass resource tokens at the Common Myna's folding table; no extra charms, shine tags, coins, token-like apron loops, or trim that could be counted.

cards.repairDirective: Latest review re-flags this card for exact resource clarity. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with crisp clusters and deliberate dithering, not realistic painting. Keep exactly six brass resource tokens beside the digital scale, centered and away from the final border/title overlay. The six tokens are the only charm-like objects: no extra charms, shine tags, coins, token-like apron loops, trim, or reflections that could be counted.

cards.name: Growing Nest
cards.description: A Clark's Nutcracker waits beside rooftop planters and scaffold rails, watching exactly seven shine-seed cache markers mature under a continuous grow-light strip.
cards.pose: Perched on a low rooftop planter rail, long bill angled toward exactly seven shine-seed cache markers ripening under one continuous grow-light strip, a small handled tool braced under one talon.
cards.varietyNotes: The nutcracker turns investment into seed-caching patience and breaks up the bowerbird cluster.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Slow-burn investment; a resource that ripens into a bigger payout if left to grow.

numberSymbolism.element: seven shine-seed cache markers ripening under one continuous grow-light strip
numberSymbolism.represents: patience, investment, and waiting for work to mature
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly seven shine-seed cache markers near Clark's Nutcracker; the grow light must read as one continuous strip, not countable bulbs, with no extra cache markers, charms, tags, or seed lights.

cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates looked realistic instead of matching the game art. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with crisp clusters and deliberate dithering, not realistic painting. Keep the Clark's Nutcracker and exactly seven shine-seed cache markers centered in the rooftop planter safe area; one continuous grow-light strip only.

cards.name: Workshop Nest
cards.description: A Common Tailorbird works at a modern maker-space bench, stitching and shaping the eighth shine tag beneath pegboard tools and task lights.
cards.pose: Bent over a plywood maker bench, long beak stitching one shine tag with thread-like fiber while seven finished tags hang in a neat row.
cards.varietyNotes: The tailorbird makes the craft loop literal and visually smaller, breaking up the weaver-heavy Nests middle ranks.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Craft loop; repeat a small action each turn to steadily produce resources.

numberSymbolism.element: eight shine tags split between seven finished pieces and one in progress
numberSymbolism.represents: practice, craft mastery, and repeated work
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly eight shine tags total at the Common Tailorbird's bench.

cards.name: Treasure Nest
cards.description: A Regent Bowerbird stands alone in a curated thrift-alley record stall, surrounded by nine shine tags, blue trinkets, milk crates, and vinyl bins.
cards.pose: Settled elegantly near the center on a low milk crate beside vinyl bins, one wing tucked close against the body, with exactly nine shine tags arranged on a modern folding display rack well inside the overlay-safe center.
streetwear: small round sunglasses perched above beak line
cards.varietyNotes: Bowerbird's real treasure-hoarding instinct made literal; gold accent marks the suit's prosperity high point.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Solo payoff; cash in accumulated stored value for a strong self-sufficient reward.

numberSymbolism.element: nine shine tags displayed in the curated record stall
numberSymbolism.represents: earned abundance, self-sufficiency, and refined taste
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly nine shine tags around the Regent Bowerbird on a centered folding display rack. Keep all nine tags fully inside the overlay-safe center; do not crop tags with the border, add extra charms, or let wing/clothing shapes read as arms.

cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates had cropped count elements and arm-like bird anatomy. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only, center the Regent Bowerbird and all nine shine tags, keep wings tucked as wings, and avoid any sleeve-arm, hand, elbow, or humanoid silhouette.

cards.name: Legacy Nest
cards.coreMeaning: Legacy, lasting stored value, family stash
cards.description: A multigenerational Baya Weaver group gathers at a modern loading-dock block party beneath exactly ten shine tags strung across one scaffold arch.
cards.pose: Three to five Baya Weavers of the same species gather around pallet benches and a roll-up loading door, beneath exactly ten shine tags strung across one scaffold arch overhead.
streetwear: mixed denim chore coats and flannel wraps
cards.varietyNotes: Multi-generation weaver flock under the arch is the material summit; market-gold lifts it above the earth tones.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Capstone economy; rewards a full built-up encounter of Nests assets with lasting value.

numberSymbolism.element: ten shine tags strung across one loading-dock scaffold arch
numberSymbolism.represents: legacy, shared wealth, and resources held by the wider community
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly ten shine tags above the Baya Weaver family group. Any visible birds must all be Baya Weavers; do not add extra charms, tags, bird silhouettes, or token-like decorations that confuse the count.

cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates overcounted resource tokens/tags. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with exactly ten shine tags total, all strung across one centered loading-dock scaffold arch and fully inside the overlay-safe area. Do not add extra charms, coins, token trim, tag-like decorations, or additional bird silhouettes.

cards.name: Nest Fledgling
cards.description: A Eurasian Hoopoe apprentice studies a single shine tag at a coffee-roastery maker corner beside burlap sacks and a compact tool tray.
cards.pose: Bright-eyed and curious, crest half-raised, turning one shine tag over in its beak beside burlap coffee sacks, a compact tool tray, and warm task light.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Fledgling = youngest apprentice; the hoopoe's barred wings and crest give a distinct silhouette.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Cheap study crew card; scouts or banks a single resource to learn a build option.

cards.name: Nest Outrider
cards.description: A Montezuma Oropendola courier cuts between loading docks and rooftops with a shine-laden salvage satchel and cargo-route tags.
cards.pose: In strong purposeful flight low over a loading dock alley, long tail swinging below, heavy salvage satchel slung across its breast, abstract route tag clipped to one leg.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Outrider keeps delivery reliability but gains a dramatic long-tailed silhouette and hanging-nest resource identity.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Mobile courier; reliably hauls and delivers resources across the encounter each turn.

cards.name: Nest Matron
cards.description: A Golden Bowerbird master curator sits in a modern parts-library alcove among labeled color bins, shine tags, and clamp lights.
cards.pose: Seated and serene on a low salvage bench, one chosen shine tag nestled at her talons, sorted color bins and clamp lights around her.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Matron = poised inner mastery of craft and treasure; her tended bower distinguishes her from the Elder.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Economy leader; grows and protects the crew's resource pool over time.

cards.name: Nest Elder
cards.description: A Malleefowl rules from a hardware co-op mezzanine above a communal scaffold-mound, pegboards, crates, and roll-up doors below.
cards.pose: Standing broad and still on a mezzanine rail above the communal scaffold-mound, wings folded, surveying pegboards, crates, and modern shop lights below.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Elder becomes a massive mound-builder authority instead of another weaver, keeping the material-builder theme with a stronger silhouette.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Faction leader; build and provide effects that grow and rally the whole Nests crew.
